title: Toy Story 5 Scores Year's Biggest Opening ($160M/$312M Global) as Bad Bunny Plays Düsseldorf
detail: Toy Story 5 — featuring Bad Bunny as 'Pizza with Sunglasses' — opens to $160 million domestically over its June 20–22 debut weekend, plus $152 million internationally for a $312 million global bow. It's the biggest box-office opening of 2026 by a wide margin, the largest start in Toy Story franchise history (surpassing 2019's Toy Story 4 at $120 million), and the second-largest animated opening weekend ever behind 2018's Incredibles 2 ($182.7 million). The same weekend, Bad Bunny performs two sold-out nights at Merkur Spiel-Arena in Düsseldorf (June 20–21) — his first German stadium dates on the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour — with 'Enséñame a Bailar' and 'Vuelve' as the nights' exclusive songs.
